paragraphs: (Yezaniah son of Hoshaya; the source cites Jeremiah 52:1.) All names beginning R' Hoshaya are under the entry R' Oshaya.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The frozen locator is Jeremiah 52:1, which in the consulted Masoretic text concerns Zedekiah. The corresponding Yezaniah son of Hoshaya name appears in Jeremiah 42:1. This does not establish whether the locator difference arose in Hyman’s print or transcription. Hoshaya/Oshaya spellings remain distinct.

The whole Masoretic Jeremiah 52:1 verse concerns Zedekiah, while Jeremiah 42:1 names Yezaniah son of Hoshaya. The supplied 52:1 locator remains unchanged and no print-versus-transcription origin is assigned. The Hoshaya/Oshaya personal titles in the separate pointer are uncollated and remain R'; the spelling variants and unbound cross-reference stay distinct.
